description: L1 Token Cost - estimated USD spend per provider per day. Rates come from pricing.yaml, which Prometheus reads at start and records as token_price_usd_per_1k; update that file and run docker compose restart prometheus when provider pricing changes.

panels.description: Estimated USD cost per provider per day. Query: sum by (gen_ai_system) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_total{gen_ai_token_type=~"input|output"}[24h]) * on (gen_ai_system, gen_ai_token_type) group_left token_price_usd_per_1k) / 1000. Rates come from pricing.yaml via the token_price_usd_per_1k recording rules.

targets.expr: sum by (gen_ai_system) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_total{gen_ai_token_type=~"input|output"}[24h]) * on (gen_ai_system, gen_ai_token_type) group_left token_price_usd_per_1k) / 1000

panels.title: Estimated USD Spend per Provider (24h rolling)

panels.description: Total estimated spend across all providers for the selected time range. Query: sum by (gen_ai_system) (increase(gen_ai_client_token_usage_total{gen_ai_token_type=~"input|output"}[$__range]) * on (gen_ai_system, gen_ai_token_type) group_left token_price_usd_per_1k) / 1000. Rates come from pricing.yaml via the token_price_usd_per_1k recording rules.
